request.style: English, female solo voice with supportive choir, piano, strings, organ, harp, choral, majestic and reassuring mood, 75 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Those who trust in the LORD
Are like Mount Zion today
It cannot be shaken by wind
It stands forever strong and bright

[Chorus]
Like Mount Zion, we are held
Like Mount Zion, we are kept
Steadfast and secure

[Verse]
The mountains surround Jerusalem
So the LORD surrounds his people
Both now and forevermore
His care is constant and true

[Chorus]
Like Mount Zion, we are held
Like Mount Zion, we are kept
Steadfast and secure

[Verse]
The scepter of wickedness
Will not rest on the land
Allotted to the righteous
So they will not reach out

[Pre-Chorus]
Do good, O LORD, to the good
To those upright in heart

[Chorus]
Like Mount Zion, we are held
Like Mount Zion, we are kept
Steadfast and secure

[Bridge]
Those who turn to crooked ways
The LORD will lead them away
With the evildoers

[Outro]
Peace be upon Israel
Peace be upon Israel
